method.method_draft: Read the diagram as an outer horizontal rectangle split into four congruent smaller rectangles: one vertical rectangle on the left, one vertical rectangle on the right, and two horizontal congruent rectangles stacked in the middle. Let each small rectangle have short side x and long side y. From the image, the vertical side rectangles span the full height of the large rectangle, so y is the large rectangle's shorter side, given in the text as 10 cm. The two middle rectangles are stacked, so their combined height is 2x, and this equals the same full height y. Thus y = 2x. The total long side of the large rectangle is x + y + x = y + 2x = y + y = 2y = 20 cm.
